title: The Lunch Bulletin
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the lunch bulletin for its fictional reader task. Search and dietary filters form a horizontal toolbar above a single-column illustrated-style dish ledger; the ingredient warning is a left margin note. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Archivo, #203D9C and #BDEBFF. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
